svg.aria-label: AgentRQ, the agent-human collaboration platform: the logo and title appear, then the open source, MCP native and self-hostable badges, the Chrome extension card with Claude Code live in the browser as its WebMCP tools tick on, the distributed memory banner for every agent, machine and fork, and twelve feature tiles from the visual task board to desktop, web and CLI.
